title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS SEVENTY-FOUR AND ONE HUNDRED AND SEVEN OF ACT NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-NINE, AS AMENDED.

text.en:
Act Numbered Eleven hundred and eighty-nine, entitled "'The Internal Revenue Law of Nineteen
hundred and four,'' as amended, is hereby further amended as follows:
a. By striking out in section seventy-four, as amended by paragraph (c) of section one of Act
Numbered Thirteen hundred and thirty-eight, the words "nineteen hundred and six," and
inserting in lieu thereof the words "nineteen hundred and seven."
b. By striking out in section one hundred and seven, as amended by paragraph (f) of section
one of Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and thirty-eight, the words "nineteen hundred and six,"
and inserting in lieu thereof the words "nineteen hundred and seven."
